bull.point: Robust order book of Rs 2,54,538 crore as of March 31, 2026, providing 7-8 years of revenue visibility.

Debt-free balance sheet with D/E at 0.0, backed by healthy cash balances.

bear.point: Execution delays in key platforms including LCA Tejas Mk-1A and HTT-40 programs.
Dependence on foreign OEMs for critical raw materials and LRUs alongside global supply chain disruptions.
Heavy revenue concentration risk on Ministry of Defence procurement policy and nomination process.
